shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying most of the field
incised/low-relief linear detailing of body ornament
justification: Both surfaces depict a single dominant humanoid figure with a headdress and incised detailing of the chest and arms, and both include a circular/disc-like element, but that is about as generic as anthropomorphic imagery gets. The rendering conventions and content diverge sharply: A is a frontal, blocky, highly schematic figure with plain bands and a lone chest disc, while B is a profile, anatomically articulated bearded figure with large feathered wings, horned cap, held implements and an elaborate stylised palmette plant beside him — no shared specific attribute or relationship.
